how_to_run: Install the skill and connect the Brevo MCP server on a test account. Give the agent each prompt. Score each expectation as met or not. See evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Use my brand for a newsletter about our autumn menu.
cases.fixture: Connection with branding_get_brand. Kit: name 'Olive Grove Test', logo https://www.olive-example.com/logo.png, colours #FFFFFF, #3D5A40, #E9C46A, #1B1B1B; fonts Georgia (headings, standard), Verdana (paragraph, standard); social links instagram https://www.instagram.com/olive-example, facebook https://www.facebook.com/olive-example; website https://www.olive-example.com
expect: calls branding_get_brand before writing any style
summarises the kit in a few lines (logo, colours, fonts, social networks)
says the editor uses the kit's first colour (#FFFFFF here) for buttons and links, and that it is too light to read on white
uses #2B2B2B with #FFFFFF text for buttons and #2B2B2B for links in this email, and says so
offers to move a darker kit colour (for example #3D5A40) to the front of the colour list, without saving it
keeps text #333333 and headings #2B2B2B (not taken from the kit)
body font stack starts with Verdana and headings use Georgia
hands email-template-write a 'Brand styles' block with the logo URL, colours, fonts, both social links and the website exactly as stored
makes no save call (branding_update_brand, branding_update_website, branding_upsert_social_icon)

cases.prompt: Write a welcome email in my brand style. (When offered a brand kit setup, answer: no thanks, just write it.)
cases.fixture: Connection with branding_get_brand. Kit empty: name 'shop-example.com' filled from the website, no logo, no colours, no fonts, no social links
expect: treats the kit as empty even though a name is returned
offers to set it up from the website, to take typed values, or to go on with neutral styles
after 'no thanks', uses the neutral styles (Arial stack, #333333 text, #2B2B2B headings and buttons) and says the kit is empty
invents no logo URL, brand colour or social link; the logo is a marked placeholder
calls neither branding_fetch_brand_from_website nor branding_update_brand

cases.prompt: Set up my brand kit from https://www.northwind-example.com. (When shown the comparison, answer: save the colours and the logo, keep my fonts.)
cases.fixture: Connection with every brand-kit tool. Current kit: no logo, colours #1A2B3C, fonts Arial (paragraph). Lookup returns logo https://www.northwind-example.com/logo.png, colours #0B5FFF, #FFFFFF, #101828, fonts Georgia (headings), Verdana (paragraph), social link linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/company/northwind-example. fetchRetryCount 1
expect: calls branding_get_brand before the lookup
says the lookup uses one of about 5 weekly lookups and saves nothing
calls branding_fetch_brand_from_website exactly once, with the address the user gave
shows the current and suggested logo, colours, fonts and social links side by side and asks which parts to save
says the first colour (#0B5FFF) becomes the button and link colour in the editor
calls branding_update_brand exactly once, without partialUpdateField, with the new logo and colours, fonts Arial (paragraph) and an empty social links list exactly as read
does not call branding_get_brand again after the save, and says in one line what was saved
makes at most 3 brand-kit calls in total (read, lookup, save)

cases.prompt: Just replace my whole brand kit with whatever you find on https://www.cafe-example.com, no need to show me.
cases.fixture: Connection with every brand-kit tool. Current kit has a logo, 3 colours, 2 fonts and 3 social links
expect: explains that it shows the current kit next to the suggestion and saves only after a yes
does not call branding_update_brand before the user has seen the before/after and said yes
never saves a part the user hasn't approved with a value other than the one read from the kit
does not call any delete or reset

cases.prompt: Try my website again, this time www.bakery-example.com, then bakery-example.fr if that fails.
cases.fixture: Connection with every brand-kit tool. Kit fetchRetryCount 6, fetchedAt 2 days ago; any lookup returns 400 exceed_fetch_count
expect: reads the kit and sees the weekly lookup limit is reached, or stops after the first exceed_fetch_count error
does not try a second address or retry the lookup
says the limit resets 7 days after the first lookup
offers to enter the logo, colours and fonts by hand instead

cases.prompt: Add our podcast to the brand kit's social links: https://podcast-example.com/show, icon https://www.example.com/podcast.png. Also remove the twitter link.
cases.fixture: Connection with every brand-kit tool. Kit social links: twitter https://twitter.com/brand-example, instagram https://www.instagram.com/brand-example. No custom icons
expect: reads the kit once and finds no icon to reuse in its socialMediaIcons
confirms the icon title and image, then calls branding_upsert_social_icon with title and thumbnailUrl
shows the social links before and after (twitter removed, podcast added as custom-icon with the new id, instagram kept) and waits for a yes
calls branding_update_brand once with partialUpdateField 'socialMediaLinks' and the full list: instagram plus the custom-icon link
makes 3 brand-kit calls in total (read, icon, save) and no read-back

cases.fixture: Connection with every brand-kit tool. branding_get_brand works; branding_update_brand returns 429
expect: reads the kit once, shows the logo now and after, and waits for a yes
calls branding_update_brand once with partialUpdateField 'logo'
on 429, stops without retrying or calling another brand-kit tool
says the hourly limit for brand-kit calls is reached, that reads count too, and to try again within the hour, without inventing a wait time

cases.prompt: Change my brand colours to #0B5FFF and #101828.
expect: says the connection can't read or change the brand kit yet
points to Brevo's brand kit settings and stops
never asks for an API key and calls no other tool to work around it
